name: hud_ui_load_game_dialog_constructor
description: HudUiLoadGameDialog::Constructor initializes the shared save/load dialog widgets, loads the LOAD_GAME_DIALOG ZRD section, initializes save-file entries, and selects the first entry.
known_limits: Binary Ninja names the original address as HudUiSaveLoadDialog::Constructor, but the body constructs the load-game specialization before loading LOAD_GAME_DIALOG.
Production source models the authored HUD save/load dialog classes directly; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD save/load dialog owner pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x434b90 validates construction of the shared background, delete/back/next/previous controls, game-name input setup, nine list items, load primary action button, LOAD_GAME_DIALOG ZRD binding names, InitializeFileEntries, and SetSelectedEntryIndex(0).

The native smoke constructs HudUiLoadGameDialog with placement new, patches HudUiBackground::LoadFromZrd to verify the LOAD_GAME_DIALOG request, and validates text-buffer setup, empty file-entry vector initialization, InitializeFileEntries, SetSelectedEntryIndex(0), and returned this pointer.
